name: XLA_SOURCES_B
description: This table contains all subledger sources and sources customized by the user. These sources are used to create accounting rules and conditions.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example. Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is a standard or system source.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that determines the data type associated with a source.

columns.name: PLSQL_FUNCTION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the PL/SQL function. Not application for standard sources.

columns.name: FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a group of values and related attributes assigned to a key flexfield segment (account) or to a descriptive flexfield segment. Values in each value set have the same maximum length, validation type, and alphanumeric option.

columns.name: SUM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source value will be summed.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Visible flag that indicated if the source shows up in the list of values.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is enabled.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TRANSLATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates wheter a source is translatable.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Group of lookup codes, where a lookup code is the internal name of a value defined in an Oracle Workflow.

columns.name: VIEW_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: View application identifier of the lookup type.

columns.name: KEY_FLEXFIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is related to any key flexfield.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting flexfield segment associated with the source.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Stores the flexfield application if the KEY_FLEXFIELD_FLAG is checked.

columns.name: ID_FLEX_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier of key flexfield.

columns.name: SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Source base column name. This could be different from the SOURCE_CODE.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Source table name.  Indicates the table from which source can be derived.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: SPLIT_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is used as a criteria when spitting large transactions.

columns.name: SUMMARIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is used to summarize source transaction lines.
